# mtncloud_archive_file_link (Resource)

A download link to an archive file: anyone with its URL can download the file **without logging in**, until it expires. The link's secret is kept in the Terraform state (sensitive). Once the link has expired or was deleted in the console, the next plan makes a new one; an expired link stays listed in the console, where it no longer works. Changing an argument replaces the link.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Anyone with the URL can download the report, without logging in, for one day.
resource "mtncloud_archive_file_link" "report" {
  file_id        = mtncloud_archive_file.report.id
  expire_seconds = 86400
}

output "report_url" {
  value     = mtncloud_archive_file_link.report.download_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expire_seconds` (Number) How long the link works, in seconds, from when it is made. `0` means it never expires: anyone who ever gets the URL can download the file until the link is destroyed.
- `file_id` (String) The file's ID (`mtncloud_archive_file.x.id`).

### Read-Only

- `download_count` (Number) How many times the link was used.
- `download_url` (String, Sensitive) The public download URL, with the secret in it.
- `expires_at` (String) When the link expires (RFC 3339); empty when it never does.
- `id` (String) `<file_id>/<link_id>`.
- `link_id` (String) The link's ID.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The link's secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_archive_file_link.report <file_id>/<link_id>
```
